source.description: Written by Ekos Labs from its own launch films: nine recipes with the original source code, frame sheets (shot lists for the two films cut from public figures and news footage) and review notes, a runnable Remotion template with a coded 3D character, and audio, mastering and contact-sheet scripts. Credits the video-use method (browser-use, MIT) and Bang Motion (HTML films) as methods used; no upstream files are bundled. Fonts install from npm (SIL Open Font License).

dependencies: Remotion 4 and three.js (installed by the bundled template)
Optional: ElevenLabs API key for voices
Optional: mlx-whisper or faster-whisper for exact word timing
Optional: yt-dlp (latest, via uvx) for references and footage
